pages.title: Step 1: Building the Kiln
pages.text: First, place the pit kiln block on the ground, then surround it with dirt blocks in a 3×2×2 U-shape structure.$(br2)The pit kiln's opening faces the direction opposite to where you placed it.$(br2)The U-shape consists of: left and right walls (2 high each), back wall (2 high), front top edge, and front left/right pillars. The front is left open for the fire mouth.

pages.name: Pit Kiln U-Shape Structure
pages.text: U-shaped dirt wall structure (first layer). Pit kiln in the center, surrounded by dirt blocks.

pages.title: Insulation Grade
pages.text: The number of dirt blocks surrounding the pit kiln directly affects insulation and maximum temperature:$(br2)$(li)4 sides dirt: §aExcellent§r — Max 900℃ (1200℃ with blowpipe)$(br)$(li)3 sides dirt: §eGood§r — Max 750℃$(br)$(li)2 sides dirt: §6Fair§r — Max 600℃$(br)$(li)1 side dirt: §cPoor§r — Max 410℃$(br)$(li)0 sides dirt: §4Very Poor§r — Max 260℃$(br2)Better insulation means faster heating and higher max temperature. Aim for at least 3 sides.

pages.title: Valid Insulation Blocks
pages.text: The following blocks count as valid insulation:$(br)$(li)Dirt$(br)$(li)Grass Block$(br)$(li)Coarse Dirt$(br)$(li)Rooted Dirt$(br)$(li)Podzol$(br)$(li)Mycelium$(br)$(li)Mud$(br)$(li)Packed Mud$(br)$(li)Mud with Mangrove Roots
The fire mouth is the fuel entry and ignition point of the kiln. Right-click the opening to place it, ensuring correct orientation.

pages.name: Kiln Second Layer
pages.text: Second layer (top): enclosed dirt wall, with the kiln top left open for grate installation.

pages.title: Installing the Grate
pages.text: After placing the fire mouth, right-click the top of the pit kiln with a grate. The grate dramatically improves combustion efficiency.$(br2)With grate: 100% efficiency. Without: only 30% — meaning 3x less fuel efficiency.$(br2)§cImportant: No items (greenware or fuel) can be placed into the kiln without the grate installed.$(br2)Once installed, the kiln enters Stage 1 and is ready for loading.

pages.title: Drying Rack
pages.text: Greenware items must be dried on a drying rack before use. Right-click the drying rack with any of the greenware types (crucible, mold, brick, blowpipe) to place them. Wait for them to dry, then load them into the kiln.$(br2)The drying rack can also dry other items (wet sponge, kelp, leaves, etc.).
